text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-random that the ticket is **#88412**.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He confirmed the account was Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. I checked that Hollis is a member of #central-team before reading it, and the reply uses only what Hollis can see there.

The knowledge brain also turned up a separate Door 6 ticket for this customer: #4912, a "phantom lock" when trucks check in at the guard shack at their Marietta plant. That came from an email forwarded by June Osei-Lark (deal desk), which Hollis may not be able to see, and it's a different problem from the tablet freezing. So I left it out of the reply.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I told Tobias in a thread reply in #central-random that the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he can see it himself. I also added Hollis's warning for the weekly notes: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs fixing before anyone reimports, or they'll get duplicate doors.

The knowledge brain mentions other Marrow ticket numbers (#PD-88412, #PD-88309, SUP-5102), but none of them is about the Eastbank import, so I left them out.
